en.details:
Dear Metas,

Once Human's brand-new survival scenario, Isles of Abyss, officially launches on October 21 (PT)! To help you prepare, here is the server opening schedule.
For more details about the scenario, please check:

https://www.oncehuman.game/news/devBlog/20261016/40781_1316818.html

1. Isles of Abyss Server Opening Schedule

1.1 Server Opening Schedule Announcement

After the version update on October 21, 2026 (PT), the system will open Isles of Abyss servers that Metas can join right away. See the schedule below:

Note:

Additional Server Plan: To ensure all Metas can experience Isles of Abyss, we will open new servers as needed based on the remaining capacity of existing servers. Feel free to choose a server and jump in!

Sign Up: We will ensure sufficient servers are available when the scenario officially launches on October 21 (PT). Meanwhile, Isles of Abyss sign-ups will not be available in advance—once servers are open, you can enter directly through the scenario sign-up interface.

Server Worlds: Isles of Abyss has 12 worlds per server. …
